args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 (high): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply
nested arrays. Affected: fastjson <2.9.4 (and 3.0.x <3.1.0).
Fixed in 2.9.4 / 3.1.0. Pin bumped to 2.9.4.

args.body:
## Summary
- Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt`.

## Reason
Fixes **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. fastjson <2.9.4 (and 3.0.x <3.1.0) is affected; 2.9.4 is the fixed release on the pinned 2.x line.

## Testing
- CI run on this branch (ci-0001, commit c8b8ab7878): **passed**.
